subject: Confirmation of your flight booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on July 15th. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 9:00 AM from JFK International Airport. Please arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in procedures. Remember to bring a valid photo ID and your electronic ticket. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
